text.description_html:
Bommer 7112, Spring Door Pivot Hinge Surface Mounted

Bommer Industries has been in business since 1876, with over 125 years of quality products. Their products are American made with American steel.

Bommer 7112 Spring Door Pivot Hinge, Surface Mounted. Cast steel construction pivot hinge for doors up to 36" wide, 2-1/2" thick with a maximum door weight of 75 lbs.

Specifications of the Surface Mount Spring Door Pivot Hinge:

  • Maximum Door Width: 36"
  • Maximum Door Thickness: 2-1/2"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 75 lbs.
  • Cast Steel Construction
  • Surface Mounted Pivot
  • Double Acting
  • Maximum Swing: 130º each direction
  • Ball Bearing Pivot
  • Non-Handed
  • Adjustable Spring Tension
  • Flat Door Bracket: For doors not less than 1" thick
  • Flat Jamb Bracket: 1-1/4" Wide
  • Packaged with #12 - 1-1/4" and #10 - 1" Flat Head Wood Screws
  • Finish: Zinc Plated
  • Bommer 7112 Dimensions (PDF)

Sold individually as a set, with 1 pivot , 1 each jamb and door bracket, 1 top pivot assembly with jamb bracket, and mounting screw hardware. Enough to do one door.



** This item is Discontinued. See available McKinney 4007 Spring Pivot.
